statement.text: Let ''D=(V,A)'' be a digraph with arc-capacities  <math> c : A \to \mathbb{N}</math> and a root node <math>r_0\in V</math>. A '''k-arborescence''' is the arc-disjoint union of ''k'' spanning [[Arborescence|arborescences]] rooted at <math>r_0</math>. Is it true that if <math>c(a)\leq l</math> for every <math>a \in A</math> and there is a [[capacity-obeying packing]] of ''kl'' spanning arborescences, then there is a  capacity-obeying packing of ''l'' ''k''-arborescences?
